questions.text: The washing machine’s 2.25-hour cycle cannot finish by 21:00. What later finish time would you like for it?

explanation: The dishwasher can finish by 21:00, but the washing machine needs 2 hours 15 minutes, so both cannot meet the requested deadline. I haven’t scheduled either appliance; please give a later washing-machine deadline.
problems: washing_machine window shorter than its cycle
